name: 곡비
quote: 흐느낌 끝에 맺힌 눈물이 상처를 씻으리라.
face: 소매로 입가를 가렸으나 슬픔이 서린 눈매가 보임
outfit: 짙은 비취색과 붉은 자수가 놓인 상복
silhouette: 소매로 얼굴 아래를 가린 둥근 머리, 아래로 넓게 퍼지는 상복의 실루엣, 머리의 작은 꽃핀
visual_en: A small 2-head tall spirit with messy black hair adorned with a bright red flower pin. Her face is partially hidden by the wide, flowing sleeves of a plain white hemp mourning hanbok (sobok), leaving only her sorrowful, glistening eyes visible. A rough white hemp hood and a straw rope belt mark her as a professional mourner; the white cloth has light grey creases and shadows. A pale light blue magical glow emanates from her hands as she weeps, creating soft ripples in the air. The outfit is clearly white so she reads instantly on a dark floor and never looks like the red-clad bride ghost.
features_en: Wide sleeves covering the lower face
Red flower pin on the head
pose_en: Standing with slumped shoulders, trembling slightly while mourning.
vfx_en: Soft light blue circular ripples expanding outward.
motion_en: Rhythmic sobbing motion with a subtle body sway.
lore: 늘 플레이어와 거리를 두고, 2.2초마다 울음으로 주변 요괴의 상처를 씻는다(할드처럼 주변 몹 치유).

anim_notes.skill: wailing with its sleeves raised while a soft healing light spreads to nearby allies
anim_notes.vfx: a soft round pale healing glow

concept: 저승길 — 한국 저승 설화(저승차사 · 옥졸 · 삼도천 · 명부 · 염라). 무섭되 이 게임의 2~3등신 치비 도트, 어두운 돌바닥과 밝은 회색 바닥 둘 다에서 보이는 몸 색.

body_plan.body: A small, crying humanoid character wearing a white hooded robe with a red flower decoration.
